role: Declares the scoring-algorithm version string stamped on each ScoreBreakdown and the label for pre-stamp records.
toplevel: Two static lets only; read by ScoreBreakdown default/decoder (RecoveryScoreCalculator.swift:120,129,150).

flags.text: RecoveryScoreCalculator header says the architecture is 'v3.oct2026' while the stamped version is 'v3.1.oct2026', and the z-band parameter set carries its own unrelated version 'v2.2026-06-22' that is never stored on the breakdown, so a stored score cannot tell which band table produced it.
